name: iNTERCEPT
description: Signal Intelligence Platform - A web-based interface for software-defined radio tools including pager decoding, aircraft tracking, vessel tracking, WiFi/Bluetooth scanning, and more.
author: smittix

requirements.usb: RTL-SDR or HackRF required for SDR features. WiFi adapter with monitor mode support recommended.

config_fields.name: SDR_DEVICE
config_fields.description: SDR device type (rtlsdr, hackrf, or auto)

config_fields.name: GPSD_HOST
config_fields.description: GPS daemon host (if GPS_ENABLED is true)

notes: This application requires RTL-SDR or HackRF USB device for SDR features and WiFi adapter with monitor mode support for WiFi scanning. Access the web interface at http://<node-ip>:5050. Default credentials: admin/admin (change via config). Supports pager decoding (POCSAG/FLEX), 433MHz sensors, ADS-B aircraft tracking, AIS vessel tracking, ACARS messaging, WiFi/Bluetooth scanning, satellite tracking, and more. The app automatically detects connected SDR devices via SoapySDR.
